_note: Cross-chapter scene continuity (option A). Boundary N = between Chapter N and Chapter N+1. continues=true means Chapter N+1 opens by directly continuing the scene that ended Chapter N (same place/moment/cast). carried_others = non-protagonist characters present at the cut who must not be dropped at N+1's opening (canonical names; [brackets] = unnamed). The protagonist always carries via the per-scene persona. Detected by readers over end-of-N / start-of-N+1; see TAGGING_GUIDE.md.
